name: Gaussian Normal Estimation
aliases: Per-pixel Normal Map Estimation from Depth
definition: Deriving per-pixel normal estimates directly from the geometry of Gaussians during backpropagation, where adjustments to scale and rotation parameters update normal estimates without additional learnable parameters.
summary: Gaussian Normal Estimation derives per-pixel surface normals from 3D Gaussian geometry by treating the shortest covariance axis as the local normal, enabling differentiable gradient flow without extra learnable parameters.
